name: Teradyne, Inc.
research_rationale: TTM free cash flow near $800m supports quality, but sector sympathy after Nvidia’s reinstatement rally does not clear unresolved buy-screen valuation and earnings-quality gaps.

weekly_updates.summary:
Coverage cites a sharp November share drawdown and mixed momentum despite AI/compute-test demand and the Omnyx Edge launch.
Jefferies and trade press frame Teradyne as a compute-test beneficiary; no new SEC filing bodies arrived in this batch.
Yahoo quarterly data show stronger 2026 revenue and TTM free cash flow (~$800m), but the screen still fails FCF yield and earnings-quality models.

Since the prior refresh, coverage is only a Seeking Alpha note of a ~14% same-day bounce on a broader tech rally; no new SEC filings landed.  
Quarterly sources still show TTM free cash flow near $800m, but failed FCF-yield and earnings-quality screen gates are unchanged.  
The headline move does not address cyclical concentration or competitive test-equipment risks flagged earlier.

Chip-sector coverage cites bargain-hunting after Nvidia’s CEO reinstatement and a Monday AI/semiconductor bounce; nothing Teradyne-specific beyond sympathy trading.  
The news batch is mostly options quotes; filings index refreshed with no new SEC bodies since the 30 Oct 2026 10-Q.  
Yahoo TTM free cash flow remains about $800m; the buy screen signal is unchanged and research still cannot confirm prior valuation/quality concerns.
